symptom: Original and Android14 profiles run on real PS Vita, but front-touch presses do not activate the original game's touch controls.

engine_contract.evidence: Original TCBManajer.Run queries KeyData using IDs 0 through 4 each frame before ClearBegin().
engine_contract.problem: The Vita input adapter passed SceTouchReport.id directly. Hardware IDs are continuity identifiers and are not guaranteed to equal the compact 0..4 IDs consumed by the original engine.
engine_contract.fix: Track raw Vita IDs privately and map active contacts to stable logical IDs 0..4 before publishing Begin/Move/End events to VitaEngine/KeyData.
